preconditions.description: The number of parcels n is between 1 and 500 inclusive.
The strength of the platform S is between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ini < outi < 2 * n for ini, outi, wi, si, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: For each parcel, the arrival time ini is less than the delivery time outi, both are between 0 and 2n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= wi <= 1000 for ini, outi, wi, si, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: The weight wi of each parcel is between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= si <= 1000 for ini, outi, wi, si, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: The strength si of each parcel is between 0 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= 10**6 for ini, outi, wi, si, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: The value vi of each parcel is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all((ini1 != ini2 or outi1 != outi2) for i, (ini1, outi1, wi1, si1, vi1) in enumerate(parcels) for j, (ini2, outi2, wi2, si2, vi2) in enumerate(parcels) if i != j)
preconditions.description: No two parcels have the same arrival and delivery times.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum sum of bourles Jaroslav can get.
